Image 1 is the floor plan of this room seen from above: its bottom edge is the front wall, its top edge the back wall, its left edge the left wall and its right edge the right wall. Generate one photorealistic cinematic still of this room, the front view (the establishing view): the camera stands at the centre of the front wall, at eye level, facing the back wall, with a 35mm lens and natural textures. The room layout and furniture placement should exactly match Image 1. The place is completely empty of people: no person, figure, silhouette, mannequin or reflection of a person anywhere, including behind glass, through doorways and in the distance. Location: JI FAMILY LIVING ROOM. Grand living room of a contemporary luxury mansion, seen five years earlier. The floors are polished cream marble, white marble columns stand along one side and a wall runs behind them. A long beige sofa faces a low marble-and-gold coffee table on a thick ivory carpet. Tall French windows look out on garden trees whose leaves sway in warm sunlight. Golden afternoon sun streams through the windows from the right, casting warm leaf-dappled light. A crystal chandelier hangs overhead. Show only this place as described: the doors, windows and openings it names lead nowhere new, with no other exit, courtyard, corridor or outdoor view added. Light it with the sources the description names, from their direction, at a neutral daylight white balance so that whites are white; only lamps the description names may glow warm.

Avoid: people or silhouettes, readable text, labels, signs with letters or numbers, logos, watermark.
